subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should a valid zero-overlap Skill Workshop update force operator approval even when the user explicitly configured `skills.workshop.approvalPolicy` as `auto`?
rationale: The safer exception reduces destructive-write risk but changes a recently established configuration contract and may block clients that cannot service approval prompts.

options.title: Approve the safety exception
options.body: Zero-overlap updates always require approval, with docs, compatibility coverage, and live proof clearly describing the exception to `auto`.

options.title: Honor explicit auto policy
options.body: Keep structural validation and change summaries but allow valid zero-overlap updates to follow the configured automatic policy.

options.title: Pause for broader replacement design
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers choose a separate explicit replacement or force mechanism rather than overloading overlap detection.

recommendation.title: Approve the safety exception
recommendation.body: Zero-overlap updates always require approval, with docs, compatibility coverage, and live proof clearly describing the exception to `auto`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and most recently changed the affected lifecycle approval semantics.
